name: neostack-connect
description: Connect Codex to a running NeoStackAI Unreal editor session.

interface.shortDescription: Drive a running Unreal editor with NeoStackAI loaded.
interface.longDescription: Bridges Codex to the MCP server running inside an open Unreal Engine session that has the NeoStackAI plugin enabled. Discovers the editor from the active project context, NEOSTACK_PROJECT_DIR, or the machine-level NeoStackAI runtime registry.
defaultPrompt: Connect to NeoStackAI in this Unreal project and use available editor tools.
